summary: Being chosen can make you want something more than you did before it chose you.
body: Being chosen can make you want something more than you did before it chose you. When the Sun conjuncts Venus, attention, attraction, praise, and pleasure can reinforce your confidence so strongly that another person’s enthusiasm starts influencing your own desire. There is nothing wrong with enjoying the compliment, the invitation, or the feeling of being wanted, but being valued does not automatically make the offer valuable to you. Let the attention land, then notice if you still want what is being offered once you are no longer making the decision from the high of being picked.
